chunks: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from 'Amr ibn Shimir, from Jabir, raising it, from Abu Maryam, who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) was brought Al-Najjashi the poet, who had drunk wine during the month of Ramadan. So he (peace be upon him) whipped him eighty (lashes). Then he (peace be upon him) detained him for one night. Then he (peace be upon him) called for him the next day and whipped him twenty lashes with a whip. He (peace be upon him) said to him: 'O Commander of the Faithful! You have already whipped me for drinking wine, and what are these twenty?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'This is for your audacity in drinking wine during the month of Ramadan.'
ai.seo_question: What is the additional penalty for drinking wine during Ramadan according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* illustrates the juristic principle of *tajarrī* (audacity/repetition) in Shia fiqh, where the penalty for drinking wine is doubled when committed during Ramadan due to the increased sanctity of the month. Imam Ali (peace be upon him) administered eighty lashes initially and an additional twenty the next day, totaling one hundred, establishing a precedent for the enhanced punishment of those who defy the spiritual gravity of Ramadan. This incident highlights the practical application of hadd penalties by the Imam, emphasizing both retribution and the deterrent effect of public discipline.

en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Salim, from Ahmad Bin Al Nazar, from Amro Bin Shimr, from Jabid, raising it, from Abu Maryam who said,

‘They came to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> with Al-Najjashy the poet who had drunk the wine during the Month of Ramazan. So he<sup>asws</sup> whipped him eighty (lashes). Then he<sup>asws</sup> held him in custody for one night. The he<sup>asws</sup> called for him in the morning, so he<sup>asws</sup> whipped him twenty lashes’. So he said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘O Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>! You<sup>asws</sup> have already whipped me with regards to drinking the wine, and these twenty, what are they for?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is for your audacity on drinking of the wine during the Month of Ramazan’.
